en_US: You can’t ride a Bike on snow.
It’s too dangerous.
Mt. Coronet
Snowbound Lodge
A Warm Bed and Little Else
A carved stone marker stands on the
ledge, facing south to Mt. Coronet.
Someone has brushed the snow from
its dark plaque. It reads...

messages.en_US: TEO - Lost to the mountain wind.

en_US: A wreath of frozen winter flowers
rests at its foot, and a violet
scarf is knotted around the stone.
The little lantern still glows warm.
Fresh footprints lead up to the
marker... and away again.
Where someone stood, a faint trace
of violet dust glitters in the snow,
as if a shard had been held up,
pointing at Mt. Coronet.
